purpose: turn candidate sources into clean, admissible source packages. Creates NO roots, performs NO reconstruction at scale.
rationale: the O1 phase-0 result earned this phase. The correct next move is not to find more datasets but to make the source layer trustworthy enough that when a dataset does enter, we know exactly what entered, under what permission, in what version, with what identity, and what got discarded.

transitions.requires: all four permission flags resolved from primary sources; conflicting mirrors recorded separately rather than resolved by preference
canonical name, corrected repository URL, publisher identity, version or revision, hosting location, and our own computed content hashes

sample inspected for malformed rows, duplicates, missing fields, split leakage, inconsistent ids, dead references, annotation-schema drift, markup junk, encoding issues, mirror differences; every cleaning action carries a receipt; NO silent semantic repair
admissibility package complete: pinned version, content hashes, resolved permissions, cleaned schema description, known defects, and a deterministic sampling recipe

state_machine.failure: a source that fails any transition simply stays out. There is no partial admission and no provisional state.
state_machine.regression: a source already past a state that later fails re-audit is returned to the earlier state, and every descendant built under the false premise is quarantined

stage_1_permission_audit.no_inference_from_permissive_license: synthetic_seeding_allowed must not be inferred from a permissive license unless the terms textually support that reading or the owner explicitly answers
stage_1_permission_audit.conflicting_mirrors: recorded separately; the nicer license is never selected. A third-party mirror tag is an unaffiliated claim and is recorded as such, never as a grant.
stage_1_permission_audit.owner_outreach_is_a_stage_output: an explicit question to the data owner is the only accepted way to resolve a silent flag

hashes_computed_by_us.why: finding F1: zero of 12 sources publish a per-item or per-file content hash, so the ledger's content_hash must be computed at ingest and pinned in our own receipt. Hashing is now normal ingest cost, not an edge case.
hashes_computed_by_us.pin_in: the admissibility package, not the upstream record

stage_3_raw_data_hygiene.supply_chain_note: where a source requires arbitrary code execution to load (WIQA is a known case), that is a hygiene finding in its own right, independent of licensing

stage_4_annotation_audit.ambiguity_handling: ambiguous annotations are recorded as ANNOTATION_AMBIGUOUS and are never counted as derivation failures in the agreement statistic

deterministic_sampling_recipe.why: the O1 probe must be re-runnable and auditable, and must not depend on dataset file ordering that may change between mirrors

o1_probe_contract.rationale: with zero admissible human sources, implementing a 128-256 item probe is machinery with nothing legal to touch. The contract is frozen now; implementation waits for the first cleared source.
o1_probe_contract.generic_not_dataset_specific: the implementation must accept ANY cleared source through one interface, not be written for whichever dataset answers first

intended_contract.no_prior_yield_threshold: per the ruling, no minimum acceptable yield is pre-specified. Report the components of source value; do not collapse them to a scalar yet.
prohibitions: no promotion of any probe artifact into a v3 root

program_state.V2-0: ACTIVE - implementation, audit, then the frozen cue screen
program_state.V3-A0: ACTIVE_NON_CORPUS - permissions, identity, hashes, metadata cleaning, outreach tracking
program_state.V3_corpus_construction: BLOCKED on V2-0 disposition AND admissible sources

consequence_of_the_negative_o1_result.statement: the human-grounded fraction of v3 is now an empirical outcome, not a design assumption
consequence_of_the_negative_o1_result.implication: if only two datasets ever clear permissions, v3 may end up predominantly v2-derived synthetic with a smaller but very clean human-root component. That is an acceptable outcome. A thin vein of gold beats 300,000 rows of provenance fog.

not_authorized_by_this_phase: implementing the O1 probe before a source clears
